_description: Third-party agent CLIs this package configures but never ships. Each tool lists the install routes the installer may use under --install-agents, in preference order: the first route whose availability probe succeeds is the one offered.
_policy: Nothing here is vendored. No source from these packages is copied into shared-core/tooling/, and none is a runtime dependency of the installer.
Routes are used only when the tool is absent, only under --install-agents, and the exact command is announced before it runs.
Availability is probed (brew metadata for brew routes, `npm view` for npm routes) so an unreachable registry or a renamed formula is reported, not guessed.
_verified: Route names and versions checked against the public registry and Homebrew metadata on 2026-11-20: pi-coding-agent 1.5.2 (formula), codex 0.171.0 (cask and npm), @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2.1.329 (npm).
